descriptions.zh: 逐浪者舰队上的游牧船员们给我们发来了信息。他们说他们正在从星系边缘离开并向下一个目的地进发。他们将会去哪？他们会找到他们正寻觅的东西吗？
descriptions.en: The galactic nomads aboard the Pursuing Waters fleet have sent us a parting message. They are leaving our galaxy from the outer rim and setting sail towards their next destination. Where will they end up next? Will they ever find what they are searching for?

descriptions.zh:
愿凉爽的白天和温暖的夜晚一直伴你左右，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。我们是[contact_speaker_leader.GetName]。我们代表游牧舰队，逐浪者舰队上所有的纳马里安之魂发声。

你不必对我们心存恐惧，我们的舰队无意对天体进行争夺。我们只要求受到尊重，旅程不受到妨碍。
descriptions.en:
Cold days and warm nights upon you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We are [contact_speaker_leader.GetName]. We speak on behalf of all the Namarian souls aboard the collected ships of the Pursuing Waters, our nomadic fleet.

You have nothing to fear from us, as the fleet has no interest in orb-bound affairs. We ask only that you respect our autonomy and do not hinder us on our journey.

tooltips.en: The §Y[contact_empire.GetName]§! care little for our diplomatic maneuvering.

tooltips.en: We shall seek friendly relations with the §Y[contact_empire.GetName]§!.

label.en: §EWe do not take kindly to your sort!§!

label.zh: §E滚出我们的视线，否则就开战！§!
label.en: §EKeep out of our way or we will make you!§!

tooltips.en: We shall prepare for hostilities with the §Y[contact_empire.GetName]§!, giving us §G+33%§! Spy Network growth on them.

descriptions.zh: 你们好，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。我们有个请求。在我们穿过漫漫虚空的旅途中，我们中的一些人民心生倦怠，眼中失去了目标。我们不是暴君，因此不会强迫任何人跟随我们完成旅途。所以我们在此请求：你们可以接收上述船员吗？让他们栖息在你们的[NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]上，可以吗？
descriptions.en: Greetings again, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We have a request for you. As we travel the void some of our people grow weary and lose sight of our goal. We are no tyrants, we force no one to see our quest to the end. So we ask of you: will you take some of our people in? To dwell on your orb, the one named [NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]?

descriptions.zh:
愿你沐浴和风，[Root.GetAdj][Root.GetRulerTitle]。我们发现你们称之为§Y[NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]§!的球体目前并未被你们占据。我们请求：能否让我们的一支帝国在此安家？

我们知道这是个不小的要求——失去整座星系来给我们一个家。我们等待你的答复，无论你如何决定。
descriptions.en:
Pleasant winds to you, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. We have found that the orb you call §Y[NomadMissionPlanet.GetName]§! is not currently being held by your people. We ask of you: could you let one of our tribes land upon it and make it a new home?

We realize we ask much of you - to lose an entire system to give our people a home. We await your decision, whatever it may be.

label.en: We cannot grant you this wish.

label.zh: 不，这是我们不可冒犯的领地。
label.en: No, it is ours by divine right.

label.zh: 这座星系，以及那个“球体”归你们了。
label.en: The system, and the "orb" is yours.

descriptions.zh:
很高兴再会，绿洲的[Root.GetRulerTitle]。在周围的行星之间穿行使得我们可以在废弃种群找寻有用的东西。也正因如此我们刚刚建好了我们的新飞船。

事实上我们建造出过量的飞船是为了解决的资源过剩这个问题。我们更希望商队能够保持灵活，不受束缚，所以我们带着希望达成交易的愿景来找到你们。
descriptions.en:
Greetings again, [Root.GetRulerTitle] of the oasis. Sailing through the nearby stars have made for some particularly fruitful scavenging. And so we have just finished the construction of new vessels.

In actuality we build more than we need in order to get rid of the excess resources. We prefer the caravan to stay nimble, unburdened, so we come to you with a transaction in mind.

descriptions.en: A proposal, then. We require energy credits and minerals for the next crossing. In exchange, you may have §Yfive§! of our newly-built vessels.

label.zh: 我们不相信纳马里安的工程技术。
label.en: We do not trust Namarian engineering.

descriptions.zh:
这就是我们的行事方式，不断的收集资源，随时保持我们的船坞处于运作状态，这不仅仅是我们的传统也是我们必须要做的事。比起拖累我们的舰队我们更希望看到的是我们的造物被其他天体居民买去使用。

我们能够确信我们的设计不会让你失望。
descriptions.en:
It is our way, by tradition and necessity, to scavenge resources and activate our internal shipyards when and where we can. We would prefer to see whatever excess we generate is put to use among the orb-dwellers, than have it hamper our journey.

We believe our designs would not disappoint you.

label.zh: 给我介绍介绍这些舰队。

descriptions.en: A refreshing answer, [Root.GetAdj] [Root.GetRulerTitle]. All we ask in return is £minerals£ §Y2000§! or £energy£ §Y2000§!.

label.en: We will happily ease your burden for £energy£ §Y2000§!.

descriptions.en: We had hoped to at least make back the manufacturing costs, but we can give you the ships for £minerals£ §Y1500§! or £energy£ §Y1500§!.

label.zh: 我们非常乐意为你们分担§Y1500§!£energy£。

descriptions.zh:
舰船将开往你们的中央绿洲——[Root.Capital.GetName]？是的。§Y30§!天内完成交付。

愿你们一路顺风，永远能够得到荫凉的庇佑，[Root.GetRulerName]。
descriptions.en:
The ships will be driven to your central oasis - [Root.Capital.GetName]? Yes. To be delivered within §Y30§! days.

May you always follow the trail and find shade, [Root.GetRulerName].

descriptions.zh:
嗨，天体居民。

我们有消息要告诉你们。
descriptions.en:
Hey, orb-dweller.

We've got some news for your kind.

label.zh: 纳马里安人，请表明身份。

descriptions.zh:
你们最近是不是买来了§Y5艘§!我们新制造的舰船，对吧？速度快而且装配着有大口径的武器？

事情是这样的，尽管你们不是……啊算了，我还是老实告诉你们吧。为了维护这片区域的稳定，和我们定下这笔舰船交易的国家可不止你们。你们的邻居，§H[other_empire.GetName]§!同样也和逐浪者舰队谈成了买卖。
descriptions.en:
You've recently purchased §Y5§! of the fleet's newly crafted vessels, correct? Swift of speed, with large weapons?

Here's the thing, though, you weren't... ah, given the full story. In the interest of preserving regional stability, your people were not the only one offered this deal. Your neighbors, the §H[other_empire.GetName]§! have also parleyed with the Pursuing Waters.

descriptions.zh: 他们谈下了一笔差不多的买卖，又有§Y5艘§!舰船即将被送往[other_empire.GetAdj]的首都[other_empire.Capital.GetName]。但我们并不希望舰队里的这些船最后是为[other_empire.GetName]效力，所以现在想要请你们帮帮忙。
descriptions.en: They accepted a similar offer, and §Y5§! additional craft are set to be shipped to the [other_empire.GetAdj] oasis of [other_empire.Capital.GetName]. We would rather the fleet's ships do not end up in service of the [other_empire.GetName], and we would like your help.

descriptions.en: As per our agreement with the Pursuing Waters nomadic fleet, §Y5§! military vessels have been delivered to the [Root.Capital.GetStarName] system and are orbiting our capital.

descriptions.zh: 按照我们与逐浪者游牧舰队以及其中的擅入者的合约——两支舰队总共§Y10§!艘武装飞船已经运输到了[Root.Capital.GetStarName]星系，正停驻在我们首都的轨道。
descriptions.en: As per our agreement with the Pursuing Waters nomadic fleet - and the conscientious interloper in its midst - two fleets totaling §Y10§! military vessels have been delivered to the [Root.Capital.GetStarName] system and are orbiting our capital.
